title: Claude Code bootstrap audit — full remediation queue
objective: Remediate the eight defects found by the 2026-08-30 bootstrap audit of the claude-code surface, where every readiness receipt reported READY while seven auto_invoke skills were absent from the session, a tracked generated artifact was dirtied at every SessionStart, and two governance components contradicted each other in the same banner.

audit_provenance.receipts_at_audit_time: bootstrap=ready (11/11 components READY), governance refresh=fresh, make claude-env=STRUCTURAL_PASS + RUNTIME: READY exit 0

lane_a.name: this session — non-skill planes
lane_a.rationale: Independent of skill projection and skill routing. Touch settings projection, execution-profile reporting, SessionStart banner telemetry, and command-manifest doctrine drift.

lane_b.name: separate session — skill planes
lane_b.rationale: Operator-directed split. Skill activation gating and router scoring are one coupled subsystem (skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter, AUTONOMY_MANIFEST.yaml, ops/skill_routing/, ops/generated/skill-registry.json, check_skills_standard.py) and should be changed and validated together, not piecemeal.

lane_c.name: blocked on human — no agent-side fix
lane_c.rationale: State lives in the hosted account Environment-variables field, which no agent on this surface can read.

root_causes.RC1: A runtime writer mutates a tracked, generated artifact in place, so every clean checkout is dirty within seconds of SessionStart.
root_causes.RC2: Two components hold independent opinions about the same fact with no shared constant, so they can and do contradict each other in one banner.
root_causes.RC3: SessionStart telemetry reports counts and authority claims that do not match the session it is describing.
root_causes.RC4: Authored doctrine (a rule) and a generated manifest disagree about which commands are retired; the manifest wins silently.
root_causes.RC5: Governance does not model Claude Code's `paths:` skill-activation gate, so a skill declared auto_invoke can be invisible with no signal.
root_causes.RC6: The live router scorer under-triggers relative to the trigger table governance publishes as its contract.
root_causes.RC7: Authoritative state is held outside the repository in a human-only field.

success_criteria: A clean checkout of the workspace stays clean across a full SessionStart: `git status --porcelain` is empty after the bootstrap completes.
The committed value of CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH is never overwritten by a runtime-decremented value.
No SessionStart banner reports a CONFIG DEFECT for a variable that verify_account_env.py classifies RUNTIME_MANAGED.
The `skills loadable:` banner line reports the true resolvable count (54 workspace / 55 user at audit time), not 1.
The MCP banner line distinguishes governance-managed MCP servers from platform-injected ones and does not assert sole authority over servers governance does not configure.
rules/02-slash-commands.mdc and commands/COMMANDS_MANIFEST.yaml agree on which commands are retired.
Every skill declared auto_invoke in skills/AUTONOMY_MANIFEST.yaml is actually present in a fresh session's skill roster, or is reclassified.
check_skills_standard.py fails a skill that is declared auto_invoke and carries a non-empty `paths:` gate.
The router's recall against the l9-skill-routing trigger table is materially above the measured 6/18 baseline.

out: Any change to gate semantics: merge_gate.py, local_execution_gate.py, verification_bypass_gate.py, git_guardrails.py.
Any change to the publish path (make pr) or merge authority.
Context7 MCP absence — rule 22 fallback to skill l9-context7-docs is loaded and working as designed.
The disable-model-invocation / skillOverrides explicit_only tier — 32+31 entries are deliberate, and /name invocation still works for all of them.

todos.task: Stop overlay_hosted_settings_env.py writing runtime env into the tracked, generated .claude/settings.json. Retarget it to .claude/settings.local.json, which is already gitignored at .gitignore:51 and is the Claude Code scope designed for machine-local overrides (local scope takes precedence over project scope, so the runtime values still reach the session). Keep the tracked settings.json as the pure projection of settings.template.json.
todos.evidence: Clean checkout showed `M .claude/settings.json` at 04:12:15, ~5s before the session's first tool call. Semantic delta: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH '3'->'1' plus added L9_L4_LOCAL_AUTONOMY and L9_WORKTREE_ISOLATION. Reproduced identically on the next session.
todos.risk_detail: Claude Code must actually merge settings.local.json env over settings.json env. Verify empirically before declaring done; if local scope does not merge env, fall back to `git update-index --skip-worktree` on the tracked path.
todos.verify: Fresh SessionStart, then `git status --porcelain` is empty AND the session env still carries L9_L4_LOCAL_AUTONOMY=1 and L9_WORKTREE_ISOLATION=1.
todos.completion_note: Overlay retargeted to .claude/settings.local.json. Verified: full SessionStart-equivalent overlay run leaves the tracked file byte-clean and spawn depth at the committed 3; local file carries all 17 env keys including L9_GOVERNANCE_SURFACE. 6 tests.

todos.task: Resolve the spawn-depth contradiction. execution_profile.py emits `CONFIG DEFECT: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH=1 blocks nested delegation` for exactly the value verify_account_env.py declares RUNTIME_MANAGED and documents as 'Reported for information, never as a deviation'. Introduce one shared constant both import, and make execution_profile.py compare against the committed/template value rather than the live decremented env, or downgrade its report to INFO for runtime-managed names.
todos.evidence: Both fired in the same SessionStart banner this session: `INFO: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH=1 (runtime-managed; not compared)` from verify_account_env, and `CONFIG DEFECT: ...blocks nested delegation` from execution_profile.
todos.verify: SessionStart banner carries at most one statement about spawn depth, and it is not a CONFIG DEFECT when the only cause is runtime decrement. Existing tests in test_execution_profile.py still pass.
todos.completion_note: declared_env_int reads shared scopes only (skips settings.local.json, which now mirrors runtime). Banner reads 'subagent_spawn_depth: 3 (declared; runtime-decremented to 1 at this nesting level)'. No CONFIG DEFECT. Check narrowed not silenced: undeclared low depth still reports. 22 tests.

todos.task: Fix the `skills loadable:` counter. session_start_claude_governance.sh counts with `find "$d" -maxdepth 2 -name SKILL.md` and no -L. Every entry under .claude/skills/ is a symlink to a directory, so find never descends and the line reports 1 (the single real directory) instead of the true resolvable count. Add -L. Note this is banner telemetry, not skill machinery — it is in lane A deliberately, and touches no skill projection or routing code.
todos.evidence: `find .claude/skills -name SKILL.md` => 0; `find -L .claude/skills -maxdepth 2 -name SKILL.md` => 54. User scope: 55. Banner printed `skills loadable: 1`.
todos.risk_detail: Both the adapter source and the .claude/ copy are tracked. Confirm which is generated from which and regenerate rather than editing both by hand.
todos.verify: Fresh SessionStart banner reports `skills loadable: 54` (or the true count for the scope), matching `find -L`.
todos.completion_note: find -L added. Counter goes 1 -> 54 (workspace) / 55 (user). Guard mutation-checked: reverting -L fails the test.

todos.task: Correct the MCP authority claim. The banner asserts `.mcp.json is a projection of mcp.template.json (single MCP authority)` while the session actually carried five MCP servers governance neither configures nor gates. Reword to scope the claim to governance-managed servers, and if the platform-injected set is discoverable at runtime, report it separately so an operator sees the real surface.
todos.evidence: .mcp.json mcpServers == ['graphiti-memory']. Session tool surface additionally carried github, Tavily-MCP, Vercel, Google_Calendar, Claude_Code_Remote.
todos.verify: Banner line is true as written for a session carrying platform-injected MCP servers.
todos.completion_note: Claim scoped to governance-managed servers, names the managed set [graphiti-memory], and adds mcp_platform_injected pointing at the live tool surface.

todos.task: Reconcile retired-command drift between rules/02-slash-commands.mdc ('Retired with no alias: /rules, /git-work-preserve, /harvest2'; '/update-command is retired into /dag-authoring --bind-command') and commands/COMMANDS_MANIFEST.yaml, which carries all three of /rules, /git-work-preserve, /update-command with `enabled: true`. /harvest2 is already correctly absent, which is evidence the manifest is maintained for retirement and these three were simply missed. DIRECTION REQUIRES AN OPERATOR CALL — see decision_required.
files: ops/scripts/generate_commands_manifest.py:69,83 (globs commands/*.md, defaults enabled True, preserves prior enabled)
todos.evidence: All three projected to /root/.claude/commands/ and present in this session's command roster. Manifest entry shape: `- slash: /git-work-preserve` / `file: ...` / `enabled: true`.

decision_required.question: Retire the capability, or correct the doctrine?
decision_required.option_archive: Move the three commands/*.md into commands/_archived/ (already in generate_commands_manifest DEFAULT_EXCLUDED), regenerate the manifest, re-project. Makes the rule true; removes three working user-facing commands.
decision_required.option_doc: Update rules/02-slash-commands.mdc to stop calling them retired. Zero risk; contradicts a deliberate authored statement.
decision_required.note: Age could not decide it — the session clone is shallow (single commit), so rule 91's git-history test is unavailable.

todos.risk_detail: Archiving removes user-facing commands and could break muscle memory or automation that calls them.
todos.verify: The rule text and the generated manifest agree, and the projected command set matches both.
todos.completion_note: Root cause was a half-done retirement, not a missed one: all three already existed in commands/_archived/ and only the live copies survived, which the generator's commands/*.md glob resurrected on every run. Live copies deleted (two byte-identical to their archived twins; update-command's twin strictly richer). Manifest regenerated 54 -> 51, commands re-projected, stale index row dropped. 26 projection tests pass.

todos.task: Resolve the seven auto_invoke skills that are invisible at session start because of a `paths:` activation gate. Per Claude Code docs, `paths` means 'Claude loads the skill automatically only when working with files matching the patterns'. It is a real field working as designed, but governance declares all seven auto_invoke in skills/AUTONOMY_MANIFEST.yaml and ops/generated/skill-registry.json, so the roster lies. For each skill decide: drop the gate (make it genuinely auto_invoke), widen it, or reclassify the skill as path-scoped in the manifest so the two agree.
files: skills/l9-update-agent-docs/SKILL.md — paths: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, README.md, INVARIANTS.md
todos.evidence: Correlation is exact: 7/7 path-gated auto_invoke skills absent from the session roster, 0/16 loaded skills carry `paths:`. Frontmatter is otherwise valid and identical in shape to the 16 that loaded; manifest tiers and frontmatter agree with zero divergence, so the manifest is not the cause.
todos.note: Self-defeating in this repo specifically: l9-update-agent-docs is gated on CLAUDE.md, which is loaded into every session here; l9-wire-skill-into-repo is gated on skills/**, which this repo owns.
todos.risk_detail: Removing gates widens the always-in-context discovery footprint, which check_skills_standard.py budgets at SKILLS_DISCOVERY_BUDGET=16384 bytes of name+description. Check the budget before ungating all seven.
todos.verify: A fresh session's skill roster contains every skill AUTONOMY_MANIFEST declares auto_invoke.

todos.task: Teach check_skills_standard.py the real failure mode. It currently errors only on an EMPTY paths ('empty `paths` would hide the skill; remove the key instead') and treats a non-empty paths as fine. Add a check that fails when a skill declared auto_invoke in AUTONOMY_MANIFEST.yaml carries a non-empty `paths:` gate, since that combination silently hides an allegedly-automatic skill.
todos.evidence: The existing check would have passed all seven skills in T6 — every one has a non-empty paths value.
todos.verify: Re-adding a paths: gate to an auto_invoke skill fails the gate.

todos.task: Raise skill-router recall. Measured 6 correct / 11 missed / 1 wrong against the 18-row 'Common triggers' table that rules/23-l9-skill-routing publishes as the routing contract. Consequence beyond routing: route_prompt returned None for this session's prompt, so ~/.cursor/l9/skill-route.json was never written and ~/.claude/l9/skill-usage.jsonl never created — the banner reports 'logger never wrote', but the logger does mkdir(parents=True) itself and is simply never reached.
files: ops/generated/skill-registry.json (54 skills loaded correctly — not the cause)
rules/23-l9-skill-routing.mdc (the trigger table used as the test oracle)
todos.evidence: Misses include l9-pr-remediation ('PR review / merge blockers / readiness'), l9-structured-reasoning, l9-gap-analysis, l9-context7-docs, l9-incident-response, l9-auditing-performance, l9-setting-up-ci, l9-skill-compiler, l9-wire-skill-into-repo, l9-recursive-optimization, l9-plan-simple. One wrong: 'Campaign / PE / make campaign' routes to l9-pe-campaign-activate, expected l9-plan.
todos.risk_detail: Loosening thresholds trades false negatives for false positives; a wrong high-confidence route is worse than none. Build the trigger table into a regression test first, then tune against it.
todos.verify: A regression test asserts the documented trigger table, and recall is materially above the 6/18 baseline with no new wrong routes.

todos.task: Recover the setup-script revision that exists only in the hosted account Environment-variables field. verify_account_env.py reports the field carries L9_STUB_REVISION 2026-08-29.3 while HEAD carries 2026-08-29.1 — the field is AHEAD of the repository and holds the only copy. Its own guidance: do NOT re-paste (that downgrades production and destroys the only copy); copy the field out, diff it against web/setup.bootstrap.sh, and commit what it added.
todos.evidence: Reported every SessionStart as `DRIFT: Setup script is revision 2026-08-29.3, HEAD is 2026-08-29.1`. Pre-existing, still uncommitted.
todos.risk_detail: Data-loss risk. The field is the only copy of the delta. A careless re-paste destroys it.
todos.verify: HEAD's L9_STUB_REVISION matches the field, and the drift line stops appearing.
todos.blocker: Requires the operator to read the hosted Environment-variables field. No agent on this surface can read it.

non_findings: Context7 MCP tools absent — rule 22 fallback to skill l9-context7-docs, which IS loaded. Working as designed.
32 skills with disable-model-invocation plus 31 skillOverrides user-invocable-only — deliberate explicit_only tier; /name invocation works for all, including /l9-pr-remediation.
No commit hook — by design (verification_bypass_gate --status reports model: governed_gate, by_design: true). pre-commit install is forbidden.
Plugin marketplace skipped — platform SKIP_PLUGIN_MARKETPLACE=true; plugins are not a required plane here.
Graphiti CLI and MCP both healthy; group_id=cursor-governance resolved via registry, not a forbidden default.

convergence.lane_a: T1-T5 done and committed on claude/bootstrap-audit-4jijz4.
convergence.lane_b_handoff: Start a session scoped to skills/, ops/skill_routing/, ops/scripts/check_skills_standard.py and skills/AUTONOMY_MANIFEST.yaml. T6 before T7. T8 is independent and largest. Build the l9-skill-routing trigger table into a regression test before tuning the scorer.
convergence.lane_c_handoff: T9 needs the operator to copy the hosted Environment-variables field out and diff it against web/setup.bootstrap.sh. Do NOT re-paste the field — it is ahead of HEAD and holds the only copy.
